title: ChatGPT Wallet Launches: Agents Can Now Make Purchases
summary: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT Wallet, enabling AI agents in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots to complete secure purchases with user approval and card protections.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet today, allowing AI agents to complete purchases with user approval and existing fraud protections.
- The feature integrates with ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, enabling agents to handle transactions autonomously within secure parameters.
- Users maintain full control through approval workflows while benefiting from standard credit card security and chargeback rights.


OpenAI has officially introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a payment infrastructure that allows AI agents within ChatGPT Work, Codex, and[dots](https://emergent.sh/learn/chatgpt-dots-review) to complete purchases on behalf of users. The feature, which launched today, combines autonomous agent capabilities with traditional credit card protections, creating a supervised transaction environment where AI assistants can handle commerce tasks while users retain final approval authority.


## How ChatGPT Wallet Works


ChatGPT Wallet operates as a secure payment layer integrated directly into OpenAI's agent-enabled products. When an AI agent identifies a purchase opportunity during a task, such as booking a service through ChatGPT Work or ordering supplies via dots, the wallet system triggers a user approval prompt. Once authorized, the transaction proceeds using stored payment credentials protected by the same fraud detection and chargeback mechanisms that govern standard credit card purchases.


The architecture ensures that agents cannot initiate transactions without explicit user consent. Each purchase request includes context about the item, vendor, and price, allowing users to review details before confirming. According to OpenAI's announcement, the system leverages existing card network infrastructure, meaning users benefit from zero-liability policies and dispute resolution processes they already rely on for online shopping.


## Integration Across OpenAI Products


The wallet feature is available immediately across three OpenAI platforms. ChatGPT Work users can enable agents to handle procurement tasks, vendor payments, and subscription renewals within enterprise workflows. Codex integrations allow developer-focused agents to purchase API credits, cloud resources, or third-party services during automated build processes. The dots personal assistant platform gains the ability to manage household purchases, schedule paid services, and handle subscription management without requiring users to manually enter payment information for each transaction.


This multi-product rollout positions ChatGPT Wallet as foundational infrastructure for OpenAI's broader agent ecosystem rather than a standalone feature. By standardizing payment capabilities across Work, Codex, and dots, OpenAI enables consistent commerce experiences regardless of which agent product a user deploys.


## Security and User Control


OpenAI emphasizes that ChatGPT Wallet maintains strict security boundaries. Payment credentials are encrypted and isolated from the language models that power agent reasoning. Agents receive only transaction confirmation data, never raw card numbers or security codes. Users can set spending limits, restrict agent purchase authority to specific vendors, or require approval for transactions above defined thresholds.


The system also logs every transaction attempt, creating an audit trail that users can review to understand how agents are utilizing payment authority. Failed transactions, declined purchases, and approval timeouts are all recorded, providing visibility into agent behavior and potential issues with vendor integrations or payment method validity.


## Release Date and Availability


ChatGPT Wallet was officially launched on November 13, 2026. The feature is rolling out to all ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots subscribers over the next two weeks. Users will receive in-product notifications prompting them to set up wallet credentials and configure approval preferences. OpenAI has not announced pricing changes related to the wallet feature, indicating it functions as an included capability within existing subscription tiers.


## What This Means


ChatGPT Wallet represents OpenAI's first major infrastructure play into agent-driven commerce. By handling payment orchestration, the company positions itself as an intermediary in transactions initiated by AI rather than forcing users to manage separate payment flows for each agent task. This approach reduces friction in autonomous workflows while maintaining security guardrails that preserve user control. As agent capabilities expand across professional and personal contexts, payment infrastructure becomes a critical enabler of practical utility. OpenAI's decision to launch wallet functionality across multiple products simultaneously signals confidence that supervised agent commerce is ready for mainstream deployment in late 2026.
